models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign night at Portorosa and a light-air motor-sail to Lipari - earliest start gives the best breeze.
briefing.synopsis: No active weather system is affecting the islands: winds across the archipelago are running 2-5 kt with a diurnal swing - SSE overnight, backing to NE/ENE by midday (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 03 Oct 06Z; ECMWF AIFS, 03 Oct 12Z; ICON-2i, 03 Oct 12Z consensus). Seas are effectively flat, 0.1 ft total wave and 0.1 ft swell at every island through Monday (MFWAM, 03 Oct 00Z, cross-checked by ECMWF WAM 0.25°, 03 Oct 06Z). Through tomorrow and into Monday the pattern stays the same, with a weak NW flow filling in over Lipari and Panarea by Monday midday. There is nothing in the payload to suggest a change in that over the next 48 hours.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight you are in Portorosa Marina - an enclosed basin with all-round shelter, scored sheltered with no alternative needed. Expect about 4 kt SE gusting 8 kt, swell 0.1 ft (IFS 03 Oct 06Z / AIFS 03 Oct 12Z consensus). Overnight the breeze holds around 4 kt from the SSE at 00:00 and 06:00. Nothing in the forecast would move the fleet.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Leg 1, Portorosa to Lipari, 22 nm on 342°T. The payload gives a recommended departure of 06:00, with 4.6 kt SSE gusting 10.1 kt, 0.1 ft waves and a dead run at TWA 178 - a 06:00-09:00 passage. All five windows from 06:00 to 14:00 come back 'go', so there is no deterioration driving an early start, only better breeze: by 10:00 wind drops to 2.1 kt ENE and the afternoon fills from the NNE at 4-5 kt, meaning close-hauled. Expect to motor or motor-sail most of the way whichever window you take; the verdicts are conservative thresholds, not a decision - each skipper confirms at the dock.

passage_notes.note: 06:00 start: 4.6 kt SSE, gusts 10.1 kt, 0.1 ft wave, run at TWA 178. Wind falls to 2.1 kt ENE by 10:00, then NNE 3.9-4.6 kt and close-hauled in the afternoon. All windows 'go'.
Steady NW 3.3-5.0 kt all day, gusts to 10.9 kt, 0.1 ft wave, close/beam reach. No window better than another on safety; 06:00 recommended.

NW to NNW 4.4-6.0 kt, gusts to 13.2 kt, wave 0.1-0.3 ft, close reach. Berth at Marina del Gabbiano is rated only 'workable' - open from every direction with no anchoring - so it depends on it staying calm.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (06 Oct, 11 nm, 219°T)
passage_notes.note: ESE backing SE, 2.6-4.1 kt, gusts to 10.5 kt, 0.5 ft wave. Very light; plan on motoring.
S to SE 4.5-7.3 kt, gusts to 11.5 kt, 0.5-0.7 ft wave. Afternoon gives the best angle - broad reach at 7.3 kt by 14:00.
Southerly 7.4 kt early easing to 2.4-4.4 kt after midday, 0.7-0.8 ft wave. Early start gets the only usable breeze.
The windiest day in the payload: 14.8 kt WSW at 06:00, 17.6 kt W at 08:00 (Bf 5), then 9.7-12.1 kt with gusts to 20.4 kt. Waves still only 0.9-1.2 ft. Long lead time - revisit nearer the day.
